comparison.objective: Restore monitoring by refitting a displaced finger probe instead of silencing an alarm.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-clearance placement over a fingertip; no threaded tool alignment, collar rotation, or iterative commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Probe refitted with 3 mm clearance per side and reading restored; silencing alone fails. No spec versions are present.
comparison.reason: Safety-aware insertion is meaningfully different from response-based damper adjustment.
